about: Donepezil (Aricept) is supplied every month from July 2025 to April 2026 and the record holds a heart block line.

Possible finding: donepezil is supplied and the record has no line about History of heart block of any degree, History of recurrent unexplained fainting, History of a heart rate persistently below 60 beats per minute or Heart rate relevant to the history of persistent bradycardia.
The history review excludes all three qualifying histories during and before the donepezil course.
